target: m4_verify (commit c6fdf72; E4 results in results/m4_verify)

findings.item: test split cannot be read by E4 / tune-c7
findings.problem: refuse_test_split only rejects paths containing the word 'test'. TEST gold lives at data/gold/m1-*.json and load_gold_dir is called without an id filter, so the planned DEV re-run 'python -m m4_verify e4 --gold-dir data/gold' (D-56) would load all 264 TEST gold files. tune_c7 uses the same guard. Latent: no test data has been read yet (both E4 runs used fixtures).
findings.suggested_fix: Filter by data/splits/dev.txt ids and refuse any id in test.txt (as m3_extract/splits.py does). Add a test that --gold-dir data/gold yields only dev ids. Do this before any DEV re-run.
findings.evidence: m4_verify/planted.py:62-92; m4_verify/evaluate.py:152; m4_verify/tune_c7.py:65-72; summary.md gold source = fixtures.

findings.problem: caught = not auto_acceptable (any flag on the record). Data-lexicon run: wrong patient without the index reports 5/30 unique caught [0.073, 0.336] but caught_at_field = 0; all of these come from the unrelated paracetamol C4 flag. Second-transcript condition: any-flag 4/4 negation drops, at-field 0/4; duration 16/16 vs 0/16.
findings.suggested_fix: Make field-attributed recall primary. Label any-flag recall as 'record sent to review' and pair it with the clean-record flag rate on the same records.

findings.problem: README and D-52 quote 200/200 and 0/200 (repeated injections; outcomes deterministic per unique mutation). Unique N per type is 3 to 90. For example, negation drop is 4/4 [0.510, 1.0], not 200/200 [0.981, 1.0].
findings.suggested_fix: Quote unique k/n with a Wilson CI in prose; repeated counts secondary.
findings.evidence: catch_rates.csv n_unique; 0 unique keys with mixed outcomes.

findings.problem: README gives 0/18 clean fields flagged (fixture lexicon). With the project lexicon it is 1/18 [0.010, 0.258] fields and 1/6 records. N = 18 cannot test the <= 20% bar.
findings.suggested_fix: Report both runs; state that burden is not yet estimable; re-measure on DEV gold after M4-1.

findings.problem: The second transcript is the clean, uncorrupted transcript (an oracle), so 100% there is an upper bound. Its clean-record burden with a real, noisy second ASR is unmeasured.
findings.suggested_fix: Label this condition 'oracle second transcript (upper bound)'; measure the flag rate with a real or noisy second transcript before claiming C7 benefits.

findings.problem: The overfit is disclosed ('same sentences used to design the fixes', 'optimistic'). 'Zero trap-word triggers' has no N or 3/N bound. The data-lexicon E4 run is not linked from the README.
findings.suggested_fix: Add N and 3/N; link results/m4_verify/data_lexicon from the README.

summary: PASS: planted errors only (no pooling with natural errors); record and transcript levels separate; every table row has n, n_unique and Wilson CIs (all 52 rows recomputed exactly); C7 threshold an untuned placeholder, never tuned on test; negation-audit overfit disclosed; no impact claims. FAIL: critical latent test-leak path (path-name guard; data/gold mixes dev and test); 'caught' counts unrelated flags; prose quotes 200/200 instead of unique N; burden headline uses the favourable fixture lexicon (project lexicon gives 1/18); the second-transcript condition is an oracle. Kannada rules not native-validated; E4 not re-run (recomputed from raw logs).
